trainable: decoder layers 20-27, final norm, candidate head
loss: soft cross-entropy + 0.1 * Brier, mean over questions; Typed Decisions replay in every step
selection: Evaluate step 0 and every eval_every steps on gate dev and Typed Decisions dev. A step is eligible if its Typed Decisions dev soft CE <= step 0's + 0.01. Choose the eligible step with the lowest gate dev soft CE; ties go to the earlier step. Test splits are not read.
